info.about: Drakengard 3, known in Japan as Drag-On Dragoon 3, is a 2013 action role-playing video game developed by Access Games and published by Square Enix exclusively for PlayStation 3. It is the third main game in the Drakengard series and a prequel to the original game.
info.trivia: It was made by the team behind the original Drakengard and Nier, led by director Yoko Taro, with music by Nier composer Keiichi Okabe.
info.why: It was released exclusively on PlayStation 3, with no version for any other platform.
